purpose: Explicitly classify native generators, authentic external published baselines, and internal stand-ins so stand-in prototypes are never reported as published methods.

dope_engine.notes: Native Rust DOPE engine (Format 1 and Format 2).

rows_wire_v2.notes: Overflow-free i16 per-column brotli row-subset baseline with no artificial 88% cap.

real_twin_b.implementation: Disjoint fresh real sample B of size n
real_twin_b.notes: Fresh real-data yardstick for parity harm and equivalence calibration.

real_bootstrap.implementation: Empirical bootstrap of fit sample A (evaluated under Rule A-1 duplicate grouping)

tabdiff.implementation: Isolated Python worker running upstream TabDiff (and inference-time refinement)
tabdiff.notes: Requires verified upstream package installation and prediction-bundle seam.

tabsyn.implementation: Isolated Python worker running upstream TabSyn
tabsyn.notes: Requires verified upstream package installation and prediction-bundle seam.

tabddpm.implementation: Isolated Python worker running upstream TabDDPM
tabddpm.notes: Requires verified upstream package installation and prediction-bundle seam.

arf_official.implementation: Isolated Python worker running upstream arfpy (Adversarial Random Forests)
arf_official.notes: Official upstream ARF; distinct from internal standin_arf_proj_bins.

forest_flow.implementation: Isolated Python worker running upstream ForestDiffusion / ForestFlow

ctgan.implementation: Isolated Python worker running upstream SDV CTGAN

tvae.implementation: Isolated Python worker running upstream SDV TVAE

standin_arf_proj_bins.notes: In-house random-projection quantile-bin resampling prototype; NOT published ARF.

standin_gaussian_copula.notes: In-house multivariate Gaussian prototype; NOT SDV GaussianCopula.

standin_noisy_bootstrap_diffusion.notes: In-house Gaussian-jittered bootstrap prototype; NOT TabDDPM/TabDiff.

standin_factor_rff_kernel.notes: In-house rank-4 factor + 6-unit RFF ridge prototype.
